summary: Fed held rates steady at 3.50-3.75% at April 28-29 FOMC meeting (Powell's final as Chair). Median forecast: one cut in 2026. Four dissenters — three wanted to remove future cut language, one wanted immediate cut. Fed cited Middle East tensions and elevated energy prices as sources of inflation uncertainty. Kevin Warsh nomination advancing in Senate to replace Powell.
